MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SanDisk memory card fits my repeated purchases of SD and microSD cards, and my card reader gives me another reason to consider storage for compatible devices.",
    "The HDMI cable fits my pattern of buying practical connection accessories, though I would need to confirm the ports and cable length before choosing it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Buying a TV and DVD player does not mean I currently need a streaming stick; the 4K version also adds little value for my recorded 720p TV.",
    "Another older Fire tablet feels redundant after buying a Fire 7 and its case, while Echo devices introduce voice-control uses I have not shown an interest in.",
    "Earbuds and a Wi-Fi extender could be useful in particular circumstances, but my purchases do not establish an audio need or a Wi-Fi coverage problem."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been treated as interest in a broad range of Amazon devices, even though my follow-up purchases focused on accessories.",
    "The list seems to assume that owning electronics means I want more electronics, when much of my activity involves connecting, storing, mounting, and maintaining devices I already use."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated memory-card purchases, card storage cases, and card reader show an ongoing storage-related need that matters more than a single tablet purchase.",
    "My latest lens-cap purchase and earlier tripods suggest continuing interest in camera accessories.",
    "Compatibility and a specific practical purpose matter to me: a cable needs the right connections and length, and a memory card needs to work with my devices."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my storage and connection needs but read my device ownership as a stronger desire for additional gadgets than my purchases support."
}
